fluff.overview: The Lyran Commonwealth's industrial wealth ensures its infantry are among the best-equipped in the Inner Sphere, fielding hardware that most armies reserve for elite formations as standard issue. Motorized platoons add light transport vehicles to standard infantry formations, giving them the speed to conduct rapid strikes, screening operations, and quick withdrawals that foot infantry cannot manage. Equipped with Maxell PL-10 laser rifles and semi-portable support lasers, these platoons field an all-energy weapons loadout that eliminates ammunition dependency at the cost of increased power pack requirements. These Xenoplanetary Condition Troops carry specialized survival gear that allows them to fight in extreme temperatures, toxic atmospheres, or unusual gravity conditions where standard infantry cannot operate.
